messages:
maria.csm: Hey team — Fenwick Systems (acct: FWK-829) pinged with an APAC demo tomorrow. Request: temporary rate bump for ap-southeast-1, add their egress CIDR to the proxy allowlist, and pin regional routing to APAC for 24h. Also they want a header inserted `X-Redwood-Customer: fenwick` for downstream logging. Can we do this today?
leo-ops: copy — what size bump are they asking for?
maria.csm: They quoted a peak of 1.2M tokens over 3 hours. Current QPS is ~120; asking us to let them go to 600 QPS burst window. TTL for the change should be 24h and auto-revoke.
ryan-networks: OK for routing pin—need the exact CIDR and whether this is egress or ingress. Also header injection is safe but confirm where it gets added (edge vs origin).
maria.csm: CIDR: 203.45.12.0/24 (Fenwick dev pool). This is an egress/proxy allowlist so traffic from our peered edge->customer proxy needs to allow their callback IPs. Header should be injected at the edge (ap-southeast-1) before hitting their origin so their logs can correlate.
tess-aml: quick note — if they're hitting 600 QPS with long sequences, KV cache warming might reduce cost. Recommend we enable pre-warm on the dedicated route for the window. Want me to flip that?
maria.csm: yes please, set pre-warm for the 3h window starting 08:00 SGT tomorrow.
kavi-support: I'll schedule the config. Plan: 1) create ephemeral rule set fwk-fnck-apac-temp-176800 2) add CIDR 203.45.12.0/24 to proxy-egress-allow 3) create routing policy pin: client_org:FWK -> region:ap-southeast-1 4) route-level header injection `X-Redwood-Customer: fenwick` 5) bump rate_limit -> 600 QPS with burst window 900 for 3 hours 6) TTL set 24h then auto-revoke.
leo-ops: Sounds good. Two asks: please include a rollback trigger if error rate > 5% or p95 latency spikes > 400ms. Also add a canary: apply to one edge node first for 5m.
kavi-support: will do the canary. Adding rollback thresholds and an automatic fallback to the baseline model variant (opt-1-small) if we detect degradation.
ryan-networks: one config detail — for header injection at the edge we need to map to the correct route tag. Please provide the route name that Fenwick will call (they said /fwk/v1/generate).
maria.csm: route is `/fwk/v1/generate`. I'll send them the updated callback doc and confirm they can accept `X-Redwood-Customer`.
kavi-support: preparing config snippet now: ```
{
  "org": "FWK-829",
  "route": "/fwk/v1/generate",
  "region_pin": "ap-southeast-1",
  "qps": 600,
  "burst_qps": 900,
  "ttl_hours": 24,
  "egress_cidrs": ["203.45.12.0/24"],
  "headers": {"X-Redwood-Customer": "fenwick"},
  "canary": {"percent": 2, "duration_minutes": 5},
  "rollback_on": {"error_rate_pct": 5, "p95_latency_ms": 400}
}
```
maria.csm: thanks! Also flagging renewal note — Fenwick's renewal is in 6 weeks and CS wants to show value. This demo is high-impact; if all goes well we should capture add'l usage and follow up with a package upgrade conversation. Logging and the injected header will help tie demo usage to the account.
tess-aml: I'll enable pre-warm and add a short perf eval after the window to capture regressed logits/quality.
leo-ops: kavi — please coordinate deployment and post-mortem notes in the FWK ops thread. Also add a support rotation for the 3h window.
kavi-support: on it. I'll post the rollout plan in #customer-ops and ping @oncall tomorrow 30m before.
deploy-bot: Scheduled change fwk-fnck-apac-temp-176800 created by kavi-support. Canary: 2% edge nodes, start: 1768070400, duration: 5m. Auto-revoke: 24h after start. Rollback thresholds set.
maria.csm: perfect — appreciate the quick turn. I'll DM Fenwick the support contact and the header acceptance note. :raised_hands:
